notes.title: Become a part of the community!
notes.notes:
[h2]We're trying to create and grow our community![/h2][i]
Our hope is to create a community based around people with the same interests; Therefore we want this community to grow through our game-page, rather than promoting our social platforms through others.[/i]

This is a beginning for us, a big step to take: But we hope to grow from zero to hero along with you- the community. If you've ever wanted to become a crucial part of a growing community, and helping it develop to become even greater, please consider joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/xdKcArHWQP]Official Discord Server[/url].

We also do have an [url=https://community.pixelheroes.io/]Official Forum[/url] for you veterans out there who still rather use this! We, the developers are just as active there ourself, as we are on the discord! Bring back the glorious days of forums!

[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Development Logs & Blogs![/h2]

Behind the pixels lies a lot of work, and rather than keeping this to ourselves, we want to share our progress within the development assets through Blogs and Video logs! Therefore we've create a blog-like website as well as a YouTube channel you'll be able to find our progress with different projects intern in the game. Check out both of these links here!
[list]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpNBP92R0Mp14vrzq0dGYjw]YouTube[/url]
[*][url=https://pixelheroes.io/]Blog[/url]
[/list]

[b]We're looking forward to your presence within the community![/b]
